name: Tachibana Fuyune
source: Your younger sister. She left home to enter a school that is quite far and has been staying at your grandmother's student dormitory. While making a face, she had said that she will become your future bride. As if wanting to spoil you, she would always puts on airs like she is an older sister though she is the younger one.
